article.story: DETROIT -- — Andrea Holden had 17 points and made the first of two free throws with two seconds left to help Wright State hold on for an 84-82 victory over Detroit Mercy on Friday night. Holden shot 3 of 6 from the field and 11 of 12 from the free-throw line for the Raiders (10-7, 5-1 Horizon League). Solomon Callaghan hit three 3-pointers and scored 15, while Logan Woods made three 3s and scored 12. Legend Geeter led the Titans (6-9, 3-3) with 22 points and six rebounds. Tyler Spratt added 16 points and six rebounds, while Orlando Lovejoy scored 13. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
